newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco withdraws 375 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco withdraws 375 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) withdrew 375 million dirhams from the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, the bank said on Wednesday.
The bank received bids totalling 2.869 billion dirhams and allocated 1.635 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was less than the 2.010 billion dirhams leaving the market this week.
The bank satisfied 57 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on June 18.
